firm_data.firm_description: Finkelstein & Partners, LLP, is a personal injury law firm serving clients in New York, New Jersey, and other locations. They handle a variety of cases including car accidents, construction accidents, and nursing home abuse.
notable_facts: The firm was featured in Profiles of Law for making a meaningful impact in their field and community.
Andrew Finkelstein was named one of America’s 100 Most Influential Trial Lawyers by The Trial Lawyer magazine in 2014 and 2015.

email.subject: AI for Finkelstein & Partners, LLP built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Nancy,

Finkelstein & Partners has earned recognition in Profiles of Law for making a meaningful impact in your field and community. That kind of reputation is built on precision and client trust, not just volume.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

With your focus on construction accidents, car accidents, and complex cases, you're exactly the kind of firm we work with. I'd be happy to stop by Newburgh or hop on a call to show how we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
